questions.question: Sleep inertia refers to a period of

choices.text: heightened alertness and visual acuity following a rest period.
alignment between a person’s internal biological clock and local external time cues.
impaired performance following awakening from a regular sleep cycle or nap.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Sleep inertia는 수면·휴식 직후 일정 시간 수행능력과 vigilance가 떨어지는 상태로 졸림, lethargy, reaction time 증가와 attention lapse가 나타난다. 짧은 수면이나 큰 sleep debt 후 더 심할 수 있다.
tags: Human Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.explanation_en: Sleep inertia is a period of reduced performance and vigilance after a rest period. Sleep inertia causes a feeling of drowsiness or lethargy and can be measured as a noticeable change in reaction time and potential for lapses in attention. It tends to be greater after short sleep periods of an hour or two, when the need for sleep is not fully satisfied, or after sleep when the person is carrying a large sleep debt from prior sleep restrictions. Answer (A) is incorrect. Sleep inertia is a period of reduced performance and vigilance after a rest period. Answer (B) is incorrect. A person’s circadian rhythm is the relationship between a person’s internal clock and the local time.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: A pilot does not perceive the difference between the assigned takeoff runway heading and the indicated heading. This is an example of
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 이륙 전 부정확한 cross-check로 wrong-runway takeoff가 발생했다면 이는 pilot/crew의 detection error이다.
questions.explanation_en: Faulty cross-check prior to takeoff can result in a takeoff from the wrong runway. This faulty cross-check is a detection error on the part of the pilot and/or crew. Answer (A) is incorrect. While a lack of experience may lead to errors such as this, the root cause of the error is faulty cross-check on the part of the pilot and/or crew. Faulty cross-check is a detection error. Answer (B) is incorrect. While technically accurate in this case, insight error implies that verifying the takeoff heading against the indicated heading is something that a pilot should think of or decide to do out of an inclination rather than as a requirement of established procedure. Because this procedure should be routine when taking the runway, this faulty cross-check is better described as a detection error.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM training refers to

choices.text: the two components of flight safety and resource management, combined with mentor feedback.
the three components of initial indoctrination awareness, recurrent practice and feedback, and continual reinforcement.
the five components of initial indoctrination awareness, communication principles, recurrent practice and feedback, coordination drills, and continual reinforcement.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. CRM training의 세 핵심 구성요소는 initial indoctrination/awareness, recurrent practice and feedback, continual reinforcement이다.
questions.explanation_en: CRM training is comprised of three components: initial indoctrination/awareness, recurrent practice and feedback, and continual reinforcement. Answer (A) is incorrect. CRM training is comprised of three components, not two. Answer (C) is incorrect. CRM training is comprised of three components, not five.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Error management evaluation

choices.text: should recognize not all errors can be prevented.
may include error evaluation that should have been prevented.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Error management는 모든 오류를 예방할 수 없다는 사실을 인정하는 CRM의 중요한 구성요소이다.
questions.explanation_en: Error management is an important addition to CRM training, which acknowledges that not all errors can be prevented. Answer (B) is incorrect. Error management evaluation recognizes that not all errors can be prevented. It does not identify errors that should have been prevented. Answer (C) is incorrect. Error management evaluation recognizes that not all errors are preventable, hence, errors are not considered a disqualifying event.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: The crew monitoring function is essential,

choices.text: particularly during high altitude cruise flight modes to prevent CAT issues.
particularly during approach and landing to prevent CFIT.
during RNAV departures in class B airspace.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 효과적인 crew monitoring은 오류를 조기에 발견해 사고로 이어지는 event chain을 끊을 수 있는 중요한 수단이다.
questions.explanation_en: Effective crew monitoring is an important tool that can enhance the ability of a crew member to recognize an error and break the chain of events that could lead to an accident. Answer (A) is incorrect. Crew monitoring has been identified as an effective method of preventing or breaking the chain of events that can lead to an accident, not to prevent CAT issues. Answer (C) is incorrect. Crew monitoring has been most effective in avoiding potential hazards and accident scenarios on approach and landing. While the concept is valid on departure, RNAV does not play a pertinent role in the concept, nor does the aircraft’s presence in Class B airspace.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Effective CRM reinforcement depends on
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 효과적인 CRM에는 awareness, practice/feedback, continuing reinforcement가 필요하다. LOFT, 영상 debriefing, group problem-solving, role play, attitude/personality 측정 등이 reinforcement에 활용된다.
questions.explanation_en: In effective CRM, crewmembers need awareness, practice and feedback, and continuing reinforcement. Effective CRM reinforcement depends on usable feedback from skills practice in Line Oriented Flight Training (LOFT), audiovisual (taped) debriefings of LOFT and other training, group problem-solving activities, role-playing exercises designed to develop event strategies, and the measurement of attitude and/or personality. Answer (A) is incorrect. Video and audio reviews are a form of usable CRM feedback. Answer (B) is incorrect. Effective CRM does not depend on verbal critiques.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Accident prone pilots tend to
questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. 사고경향이 높은 조종사는 규칙을 경시하는 경향이 있으며, 비행사고 기록과 운전 안전위반 기록 사이에도 높은 상관이 보고되었다.
questions.explanation_en: Research has shown that accident prone pilots tend to have a disdain for the rules. Additional research has found a high correlation between pilots with accidents on their flying records and safety violations on their driving records. Answer (B) is incorrect. No link has been shown between accident prone pilots and pilots who methodically gather information. However, research has shown that accident prone pilots tend to have a disdain for the rules. Answer (C) is incorrect. No link has been established that suggests pilots who utilize outside resources a great deal also have a tendency to be accident prone. However, research has shown that accident prone pilots tend to have a disdain for the rules.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Detailed investigations of runway incursions have identified
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Runway incursion의 주요 원인은 ATC instruction 미준수, 공항 familiarization 부족, SOP 미준수 세 가지로 확인되었다.
questions.explanation_en: Detailed investigations of runway incursions have identified three major areas contributing to these events. They are failure to comply with ATC instructions, lack of airport familiarity, and non-conformance with standard operating procedures. Answer (A) is incorrect. Detailed investigations of runway incursions have identified three major areas contributing to these events, not two as this answer suggests. Answer (C) is incorrect. Detailed investigations of runway incursions have identified three major areas contributing to these events, not four as this answer suggests.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: In order to achieve the highest level of safety,

choices.text: each crewmember must actively crosscheck the actions of other crewmembers.
each crewmember must constantly monitor their seat dependent tasks.
the captain’s judgment should not be questioned.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. Crew monitoring과 cross-check는 승무원의 핵심 역할이다. 각 승무원은 flight path와 system을 주의 깊게 감시하고 다른 승무원의 action을 적극적으로 cross-check해야 하며 이것이 사고를 막는 마지막 방어선이 될 수 있다.
questions.explanation_en: Crew monitoring and cross-checking is an important role of the crewmembers. To ensure the highest levels of safety, each flight crewmember must carefully monitor the aircraft’s flight path and systems and actively cross-check the actions of other crewmembers. This could be the last line of defense that prevents an accident. Answer (B) is incorrect. This would not be proactive toward a safe flight. All flight crewmembers must cross-check other crewmembers for possible detection errors or unsafe situations that may lead to an accident. Answer (C) is incorrect. There have been accidents in the past where the crewmembers knew the captain was not following protocol or was not paying attention to a given task and crewmembers did not question the captain. The results were fatal. Always cross-check fellow crewmembers for safety.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Human factor is the cause of an estimated
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 전체 항공사고의 약 80%가 human factor와 관련된 것으로 추정되며, 그중 많은 사고가 landing과 takeoff 단계에서 발생한다.
questions.explanation_en: It is estimated that approximately 80% of all aviation accidents are related to human factors and the vast majority of these accidents occur during landing (24.1%) and takeoff (23.4%). Answer (A) is incorrect. Despite all the changes in technology to improve flight safety, one factor remains the same: the human factor, which leads to errors. It is estimated that approximately 80% of all aviation accidents are related to human factors. Answer (B) is incorrect. While progress is continually being made in the advancement of pilot training methods, aircraft equipment and systems, and services for pilots, accidents still occur. It is estimated that approximately 80% of all aviation accidents are related to human factors.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Three out of four accidents are due to
questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Human element는 항공시스템에서 가장 유연하고 적응력이 높지만 동시에 수행능력을 떨어뜨리는 영향에도 가장 취약하다. 사고의 상당수가 부적절한 human performance와 관련된다.
questions.explanation_en: The human element is the most flexible, adaptable, and valuable part of the aviation system, but it is also the most vulnerable to influences that can adversely affect its performance. Three out of four accidents are due to improper human performance. Answer (A) is incorrect. Improper maintenance is mostly due to improper human performance. Answer (C) is incorrect. Weather related accidents are usually caused by improper human performance.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM is

choices.text: the best method of accident avoidance and error prevention.
a dilution of the captain’s authority.
one way to make good decisions.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. CRM은 human resource, hardware, information 등 사용 가능한 모든 자원을 효과적으로 활용해 ADM을 지원하고 좋은 의사결정을 만드는 데 초점을 둔다.
questions.explanation_en: Crew resource management (CRM) training for flight crews is focused on the effective use of all available resources: human resources, hardware, and information supporting aeronautical decision-making (ADM). The goal of all flight crews is good ADM, and the use of CRM is one way to make good decisions. Answer (A) is incorrect. The best method of accident avoidance and error prevention is the use of ADM and CRM. Answer (B) is incorrect. CRM has nothing to do with dilution of the captain’s authority. It enhances his or her ability to make good decisions through the use of ADM and CRM.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM training was initially conceived to

choices.text: improve efficiency by decreasing accident rates and decreasing fuel consumption.
prevent aviation accidents by improving crew performance.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. CRM training의 기본 목적은 더 나은 crew coordination으로 crew performance를 향상시켜 항공사고를 예방하는 것이다.
questions.explanation_en: The mission of crew resource management (CRM) training has always been to prevent aviation accidents by improving crew performance through better crew coordination. Answer (A) is incorrect. CRM has nothing to do with decreasing fuel consumption, but with how to perform better together as a crew. Answer (C) is incorrect. CRM training was initially conceived to prevent aviation accidents by improving crew performance. Throughout CRM training and experience, changes may be made from the initial onset of the CRM training to make the CRM training more effective.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM error management requires

choices.text: sound investigative skills on the flight deck.
effective use of all error reporting services.
error detection and error recovery training.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Pilot error를 완전히 없앨 수 없으므로 error management는 오류를 발견하고 복구하는 능력을 포함해야 하며 이러한 기술을 훈련에서 다뤄야 한다.
questions.explanation_en: Because it is understood that pilot errors cannot be entirely eliminated, it is important that pilots develop appropriate error management skills and procedures. Error management requires detection and recovery from errors, which should be addressed in training. Answer (A) is incorrect. Detecting and recovering from an error does not take investigative skills but error management skills. Answer (B) is incorrect. Error reporting services are good for feedback and training to help future detection and recovery from errors, but this does not refer to CRM error-management skills.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Cultural issues in CRM

choices.text: can be discussed if the training syllabus allows training time on those subjects.
must be addressed for each training population.
is not an appropriate topic for discussion in training.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 효과적인 CRM training은 각 training population의 특성에 맞게 적용되어야 한다.
questions.explanation_en: Effective CRM training must be addressed for each training population. Answer (A) is incorrect. Cultural issues must be addressed as appropriate in each training population. Answer (C) is incorrect. While individuals and even teams of individuals may perform well under many conditions, they are subject to the influence of at least three cultures – the professional cultures of the individuals themselves, the cultures of their organizations, and the national cultures surrounding the individuals and their organizations.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM error management includes

choices.text: error call-outs and error guidance training.
error prevention, error detection, and recovery from the error.
effective use of all available resources, human, hardware, and information.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. 모든 오류를 예방할 수 없기 때문에 training에는 error detection과 recovery가 포함되어야 한다.
questions.explanation_en: Since all errors cannot be prevented, detection and recovery from errors should be addressed in training. Answer (A) is incorrect. Error management includes detection and recovery from errors. Answer (C) is incorrect. Crew resource management should always be utilized throughout aircraft operations, but error management includes detection and recovery from errors.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Good judgment

choices.text: can be taught and increases with experience through accident-free flight hours.
can prevent more than 50% of all accidents.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. Good judgment는 교육할 수 있고, 사고 없이 경험시간이 쌓일수록 향상될 수 있다.
questions.explanation_en: Good judgment can be taught and increases with experience through accident-free flight hours. Answer (A) is incorrect. Good judgment can be taught, and it increases with experience. Answer (C) is incorrect. Statistically, 10% to 50% fewer judgment errors would be made by going through aeronautical decision making and recurrency training.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: An experienced, current and proficient pilot fails to notice the landing gear is not extended for landing. This is an example of
questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. 착륙 전 landing gear가 내려오지 않은 것을 알아차리지 못한 것은 반드시 system knowledge나 procedure knowledge 부족이 아니라 문제를 발견하지 못한 detection failure일 수 있다.
questions.explanation_en: Failure to notice the landing gear is not extended for landing does not result from a lack of systems training or procedures knowledge, just a failure to detect a problem. Answer (A) is incorrect. Problem detection is the first step in the decision-making process. This error does not result from a lack of systems training or procedures knowledge, just the failure to detect a problem. Answer (B) is incorrect. This error does not result from a lack of systems training or procedures knowledge, just the failure to detect a problem.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Crew resource management is defined as

choices.text: the use of human factors principles in the aviation environment.
application of team management on the flight deck.
a human error avoidance strategy to aviation management on the flight deck.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. CRM은 flight deck에서 team management concept를 적용하는 것으로, 조종사뿐 아니라 dispatcher, cabin crew, maintenance, ATC 등 안전운항 의사결정에 함께 관여하는 조직을 포함한다.
questions.explanation_en: The definition of crew resource management (CRM) is the application of team management concepts in the flight deck environment. This definition includes all groups routinely working with the flight crew who are involved in decisions required to operate a flight safely. These groups include, but are not limited to, pilots, dispatchers, cabin crewmembers, maintenance personnel, and air traffic controllers. Answer (A) is incorrect. Human factors principles are used in the aviation environment but are not the definition of crew resource management. Answer (C) is incorrect. While crew resource management helps reduce human errors, it also includes methods to address errors that occur.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM refers to

choices.text: efficient use of available resources: human and machine.
the effective use of all available resources: human, hardware, and information.
the effective coordination of the multidisciplinary field of human factor principles and performance.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. CRM은 human resources, hardware, charts/manual 등 information을 포함해 이용 가능한 모든 자원을 효과적으로 활용하는 것이다.
questions.explanation_en: CRM refers to the effective use of all available resources, such as human resources (aircraft dispatchers, flight attendants, maintenance personnel, air traffic controllers, flight crew, etc.), hardware (computers, flight directory, etc.), and information (charts, manuals, etc.). Answer (A) is incorrect. Available information also needs to be used effectively. Answer (C) is incorrect. CRM refers to the effective use of all available resources, such as human resources.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: CRM training was conceived to prevent accidents by

choices.text: improving crew performance through better crew coordination.

questions.explanation: 정답은 B입니다. CRM training의 목적은 crew coordination과 crew performance를 향상시켜 항공사고를 예방하는 것이다.
questions.explanation_en: The mission of crew resource management (CRM) training has always been to prevent aviation accidents by improving crew performance through better crew coordination. Answer (A) is incorrect. The goal of crew resource management (CRM) training is to improve communication between crewmembers, not to improve technical skills. Answer (C) is incorrect. Rather than simply improving crew cooperation, the mission of crew resource management (CRM) training is to prevent aviation accidents by improving crew performance through better crew coordination.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: One purpose of Crew Resource Management (CRM) is to give crews tools to

choices.text: reduce the need for outside resources.

questions.explanation: 정답은 A입니다. CRM은 ADM을 지원해 안전관련 hazard를 선제적으로 인식하고 관련 risk를 완화하는 데 초점을 둔다.
questions.explanation_en: CRM is focused on supporting ADM to proactively recognize safety-related hazards and mitigate the associated risks. Answer (B) is incorrect. Maintaining currency with regulations is the responsibility of each PIC. Answer (C) is incorrect. The purpose of CRM is to manage all resources, both onboard and from outside sources.

questions.subject: ATP Gleim
questions.study_unit_title: Aeromedical Factors and Aeronautical Decision Making (ADM)
questions.question: Stress distraction can interfere with judgment to the extent that

choices.text: physical response rates to stimuli are impaired.

questions.explanation: 정답은 C입니다. Stress는 신체적·심리적 요구에 대한 몸의 반응이며 상황을 인식하고 해석하는 방식에도 영향을 줄 수 있다.
questions.explanation_en: Stress is the body’s response to physical and psychological demands placed upon it, and it can cause a person to perceive situations in different ways. Answer (A) is incorrect. Whether a risk is warranted is part of the risk management assessment of a given situation. Answer (B) is incorrect. Impaired responses to physical stimuli is a function of hypoxia, hyperventilation, or other chemical influences.

choices.text: 이류무(advection fog)는 온난 습윤한 공기가 한랭한 지표면 위로 이동할 때 발생한다.
전선무(frontal fog)는 공기의 팽창으로 냉각되는 습윤한 공기에 의해 발생한다.
빙무(ice fog)는 대단히 저온이고 바람이 없을 때 발생한다.
증기무(steam fog)는 찬 공기가 높은 온도의 수면 위를 지날 때 발생한다.

choices.text: 기단 뇌우는 약 1~2시간 정도 지속되면서 강한 비와 돌풍을 동반하기는 하나, 그 수명이 짧고 규모가 작다.

questions.question: 항공기 표면에 착빙이 가장 발생하기 쉬운 온도는?
questions.explanation: 착빙의 영향과 형성조건은 다음과 같다. 1. 항공기에 착빙이 발생하면 양력이 감소하고, 항력 및 중량은 증가한다. 그 결과 실속속도는 증가하 고 항공기 성능은 저하된다. 아울러 착빙이 외부에 노출된 항공기의 가변표면에 누적되면 조종에 영 YS 준다. LE pitot 878[00에 착빙이 발생하면 동정압 계통 계기에 장애가 발생할 수 있으며, 안 테나에 착빙이 생기면 무선통신에 장애를 일으킬 수 있다. 2. 착빙 형성조건 가. 대기 중에 과냉각물방울이 존재해야 하다. 나. 항공기 표면의 자유대기온도가 OT 미만이어야 한다. 3. 과냉각물방울은 0~-20 CHA 가장 자주 관측되므로 이 온도 범위 내에 있는 HSS AYO] 가능 성이 있다고 보아야 하며, 착빙은 보통 0~-10"에서 가장 잘 발생한다.

questions.subject: 항공기상
questions.question: 태풍이 비행에 있어 가장 위험을 초래하는 것은 무엇 때문인가?
questions.explanation: 태풍의 특성은 다음과 같다. 1. 태풍의 구조 및 특성 가. 태풍은 지름 200~1,500 km, 높이 10~15 로 수평 규모가 상대적으로 매우 크다. 나. 태풍 중심 부근으로 갈수록 풍속이 강해지고, 기압은 급격히 낮아진다. 따라서 등압선의 AAS 중심에 가까워질수록 조밀해진다. 다. 태풍의 중심부에는 하강기류가 있어 바람이 약하고, 부분적으로 맑은 날씨가 나타나는데 이것이 AE] 눈(656)이다. 태풍의 눈 주위에는 소용돌이치는 강한 상승기류에 의해 형성된 적운 또는 A 란운의 구름벽이 회전하고 있으며 풍속이 가장 크다. 이곳의 구름은 적란운이므로 심한 난기류와 착빙 등을 동반한다. 2. 태풍의 이동 북반구에서 태풍의 진행방향 오른쪽의 바람은 강해지고 왼쪽은 약해진다. 이때 진행방향의 오른쪽 반원을 위험반원(61@쑤띠)이라고 하고, 바람이 상대적으로 약한 왼쪽 반원을 7A A (AT MLPA) 또는 안전반원이라고 한다. 이중에 오른쪽 반원의 전방이 가장 위험한 부분이다. 3. 태풍 부근에서의 비행 가. 북반구의 경우 태풍 진행방향의 왼쪽으로 비행하는 것이 유리하다. 저고도 비행 시 태풍의 눈을 오 른쪽에 두고 비행하면 배풍을 받고 비행하여 비행시간을 줄일 수 있다. 나. 태풍 부근을 비행할 때 정확한 진고도를 구하기 위해서는 전파 고도계(78010 altimeter) S 사용 하여야 한다. 다. 항공기를 주기(68ㅁㅁ8)할 때는 전복되는 것을 방지하기 위하여 가능하면 기수를 바람이 부는 방 향으로 향하게 하여야 한다. questions.explanation: 〉 윈드시어(\100 shear) 1. 윈드시어란 바람의 급격한 움직임으로 인하여 발생하는 짧은 거리에 있어서의 풍향과 풍속의 급변 현상을 말한다. 윈드시어는 모든 고도에서 발생 가능하지만 지상 22000 범위 내에서 항공기가 이 착륙하는 짧은 시간 동안에 발생하는 저고도 윈드시어(10\ level wind shear) = 더욱 위험하다. 2. 윈드시어(0100 811681)와 관련된 기상현상 가. 청천난류(01687 air turbulence) 나. 전선대(00681 zone) : 기온차가 5 이상일 때, 그리고 전선의 이동속도가 30 이상이 되 면 저고도로 전선을 횡단할 때 윈드시어의 가능성이 현저해진다. 다. 저고도 기온역전(10\ level temperature inversion) : 맑고 바람이 약한 야간에 지표 부근에 기온 FASO 생겼을 때, FSA AAS 하충의 안정충에 비해 비교적 풍속이 크기 때문에 상부 2,000~4,000 의 풍속이 최소 25 이상일 때는 풍속차로 윈드시어가 발생할 수 있다. 3. 저고도 윈드시어(10\ level wind 811687)의 발생 징후 지시되는 항공기 SEAS 수직속도계의 심한 변동은 거의 대부분 윈드시어와 연관된 것이다. 또 다른 인식자는 대기속도와 대지속도 사이에 큰 차이가 있을 때 이다. 이 두 속도와 연관된 큰 변화도 윈드시어와 관련이 있다. 관성항법장치(1818)를 장착한 항공기 조종사는 ASS ASHE 고도와 활 주로 사이의 윈드시어를 알기 위하여 현재 고도의 바람과 보고된 지상풍을 비교할 수 있다.

questions.question: 등압선에서 알 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 일기도에서 등압선의 분석 방법은 다음과 같다. 1. 등압선은 반드시 폐곡선이 되든가 아니면 일기도의 가장자리에서 끝나게 된다. 2. 등압선은 서로 교차하거나 도중에 두 갈래로 갈라지지 않는다. 또한 두 등압선은 한 등압선으로 합 쳐지지 않으며 도중에 끊어지지도 않는다. 3. 두 등압선의 간격은 풍속에 반비례하도록 그린다. 그러나 특별히 풍속 차가 없는 한 가급적 AAS 일정하게 그린다. 4. 대칭적인 두 고기압이나 두 저기압 사이에는 같은 기압값의 두 등압선이 서로 마주보나 흐름은 서로 반대 방향이다. 5. 해양에서의 기압 관측값은 오차가 큰 경우가 많고, 뇌우가 있는 곳에서도 오차가 큰 경우가 많아 기 압값의 신뢰도가 떨어진다. 등압선을 그릴 때 SAAS 바람보다 기압값을 더 중요시하고, 해상에 서는 기압값보다 바람을 더 중요시해야 한다. 6. 바람은 등압선을 따라 고기압에서 저기압으로 불기 때문에 풍향에 대한 표시가 없어도 등압선을 보 면 대략적인 풍향을 알 수 있고, 등압선의 간격을 보면 풍속을 알 수 있다.

questions.subject: 항공기상
questions.question: 뇌우에 관한 설명 중 맞는 것은?

choices.text: 발달기에는 상승기류, 성숙기에는 상승 및 하강기류, 소멸기에는 하강기류가 존재하므로 비행 시 모든 단계에서 주의해야 한다.
발달기에는 약한 상승기류만 존재하며, 강수가 시작되지 않기 때문에 비행에 위험하지 않다.
성숙기에는 상승 및 하강기류가 공존하고, 강수가 시작되므로 성숙기에만 비행에 주의하면 된다.
소멸기에는 하강기류만 있으며 강수가 끝나기 때문에 비행에 위험하지 않다.

questions.explanation: 뇌우는 발달기·성숙기·소멸기마다 강한 기류가 존재할 수 있으므로 단계와 관계없이 비행에 주의해야 한다.
